Identity system

The framed aperture

A substantial four-sided frame surrounds an open central aperture, with two precise diagonal separations creating depth, perspective and a distinctive sense of focus.

Primary symbol

Built from the Consello square

The frame carries the visual authority of the Consello square. The open center creates focus and depth, while the two diagonal separations introduce perspective without adding visual noise.

Heavy by design

The outside frame must remain substantial at every size. The open center must also remain generous enough that the mark reads as an aperture — never as a thin line running through a box.

Motion system

The aperture resolves.

Motion is restrained and purposeful: the frame establishes context, the center resolves, and the diagonal connections complete the system.

01 — Establish

The outer frame appears first, creating the Consello-derived structure.

02 — Focus

The open aperture becomes clear as the surrounding planes resolve into place.

03 — Connect

The diagonal separations become visible as the four planes lock into their final geometry.
